summary: Lists the operator controller-manager pods and the pods each component adds (controller web, task, mesh ingress, postgres; hub web, task, API, worker; EDA API, activation, worker, stream, scheduler; gateway and gateway redis); a missing pod often means a pull secret is needed, so check oc describe pod for ImagePullBackOff.
